env.ROCPROF_EXTRA_COUNTERS_CONTENTS:
rocprofiler-sdk:
  counters-schema-version: 1
  counters:
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_GRBM_COUNT_MAX
    description: max of gfx950 GRBM_COUNT; Tie High - Count Number of Clocks
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(GRBM_COUNT,max)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE_MAX
    description: max of gfx950 GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE; The GUI is Active
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE,max)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_WAVE_CYCLES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_WAVE_CYCLES; The cycles spent executing waves in
      the CUs. This value is reported per-SE (aggregates of SIMD values) and is nondeterministic.
      Units are in quad-cycles (4 cycles). Useful for determining how much time is
      spent executing wave code vs overhead/waiting. Low cycle count relative to actual
      number of cycles processed by the CU can indicate that the CU is stalling or
      is overloaded.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_WAVE_CYCLES,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_WAVES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_WAVES; Count number of waves sent to distributed
      sequencers (SQs). This value represents the number of waves that are sent to
      each SQ. This only counts new waves sent since the start of collection (for
      dispatch profiling this is the timeframe of kernel execution, for agent profiling
      it is the timeframe between start_context and read counter data). A sum of all
      SQ_WAVES values will give the total number of waves started by the application
      during the collection timeframe. Returns one value per-SE (aggregates of SIMD
      values).
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_WAVES,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_WAIT_ANY_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_WAIT_ANY; Number of wave-cycles spent waiting for
      anything (per-simd, nondeterministic). Units in quad-cycles(4 cycles)
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_WAIT_ANY,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_WAIT_INST_ANY_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_WAIT_INST_ANY; Number of wave-cycles spent waiting
      for any instruction issue. Units in quad-cycles(4 cycles).
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_WAIT_INST_ANY,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_ACTIVE_INST_ANY_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_ACTIVE_INST_ANY; Number of cycles each wave spends
      working on any type of instruction. Useful in determining percentage of time
      spend executing wave workloads (see WaveExec). This value is returned on a per-SE
      (aggregate of values in SIMDs in the SE) basis with units in quad-cycles(4 cycles).
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_ACTIVE_INST_ANY,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_BUSY_CYCLES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_BUSY_CYCLES; Number of clock cycles there are active
      waves in a shader engine (as reported by the distributed sequencer). This value
      does not denote the number of active waves, only the clock cycle in which any
      wave is present in a SE. This value is returned on a per-shader engine basis
      in clock cycles.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_BUSY_CYCLES,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES; Number of cycles the MFMA
      (Matrixed-Fused-Multiply-Add) ALU is busy. This value is returned on a per-SIMD
      basis.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_INSTS_VALU_MFMA_MOPS_F8_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_INSTS_VALU_MFMA_MOPS_F8; The number of math operation
      on F8 datatype. Captures add or mul ops performed divided by 512. The value
      is returned per-SE (aggregate of values in SIMDs in the SE). See AMD CDNA3 ISA
      for more information on MFMA F8 instructions.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_INSTS_VALU_MFMA_MOPS_F8,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_32B_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_32B; Number of 32-byte TCC/EA read
      requests due to DRAM traffic, 1 64-byte request will be counted to 2, 128-byte
      as 4.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_32B,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_WRREQ_WRITE_DRAM_32B_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TCC_EA0_WRREQ_WRITE_DRAM_32B; Number of 32-byte TCC/EA
      write requests due to DRAM traffic, 1 64-byte request will be counted to 2.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TCC_EA0_WRREQ_WRITE_DRAM_32B,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_TCP_TA_ADDR_STALL_CYCLES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TCP_TCP_TA_ADDR_STALL_CYCLES; TCP stalls TA addr interface.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_BUSY_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_TAGRAM0_REQ_SUM

    description: sum of gfx950 TCP_TAGRAM1_REQ; Total L2 requests that mapped to tagram

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_TAGRAM2_REQ_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_TAGRAM3_REQ_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TA_BUFFER_WAVEFRONTS_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TA_BUFFER_TOTAL_CYCLES_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_UTCL1_SERIALIZATION_STALL_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_UTCL1_THRASHING_STALL_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_UTCL1_STALL_INFLIGHT_MAX_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM_CREDIT_STALL_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_RDREQ_GMI_CREDIT_STALL_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TCC_EA0_RDREQ_GMI_CREDIT_STALL,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_WRREQ_DRAM_CREDIT_STALL_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_WRREQ_GMI_CREDIT_STALL_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TCC_EA0_WRREQ_GMI_CREDIT_STALL; Number of cycles a
      EA write request was stalled because the interface was out of GMI credits.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TCC_EA0_WRREQ_GMI_CREDIT_STALL,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TA_ADDR_STALLED_BY_TC_CYCLES_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TA_ADDR_STALLED_BY_TC_CYCLES,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TA_TA_BUSY_SUM

      for this counter.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(TA_TA_BUSY,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_VMEM_TA_ADDR_FIFO_FULL_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_VMEM_TA_ADDR_FIFO_FULL; Number of cycles texture
      requests are stalled due to full address fifo in TA. (nondeterministic, unwindowed)
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_VMEM_TA_ADDR_FIFO_FULL,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT; The number of cycles LDS (local
      data store) is stalled by bank conflicts. This value is returned on a per-SE
      (aggregate of values in SIMDs in the SE) basis.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_LDS_BANK_CONFLICT,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SQ_WAIT_INST_LDS_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SQ_WAIT_INST_LDS; Number of wave-cycles spent waiting
      for LDS instruction issue. In units of 4 cycles. (per-simd, nondeterministic)
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SQ_WAIT_INST_LDS,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_RFIFO_STALL_CYCLES_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TCP_RFIFO_STALL_CYCLES; Memory Request fifos full stall
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCP_READ_TAGCONFLICT_STALL_CYCLES_SUM

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TA_BUFFER_READ_WAVEFRONTS_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 TA_BUFFER_READ_WAVEFRONTS; Number of buffer read wavefronts
      processed by TA.
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_TCC_EA0_RDREQ_32B_SUM

    definitions:

    definitions:

  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SPI_CSN_BUSY_SUM

    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SPI_CSN_NUM_THREADGROUPS,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SPI_CSN_WINDOW_VALID_SUM

      = 1, source is CS1; DEBUG_PIPE_SEL = 2, source is CS2; DEBUG_PIPE_SEL = 3, source
      is CS3; default, source is CS0;
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SPI_CSN_WINDOW_VALID,sum)
  - name: OPUS_GFX950_SPI_RA_REQ_NO_ALLOC_SUM
    description: sum of gfx950 SPI_RA_REQ_NO_ALLOC; Arb cycles with requests but no
      allocation. Source is RA0
    properties: []
    definitions:
    - architectures:
      - gfx950
      expression: reduce(SPI_RA_REQ_NO_ALLOC,sum)
